The director had intended to save human lives; the engineers had never measured the effect on migration. He Yan wrote a revised design using the existing emergency release lever and adding a backup alarm. Lu Que drew the resting cliffs that would be protected if the signal stopped crossing them. They had found the cause, but not yet a safe way to change it. From the chamber window, the three side towers shone faintly beneath the clouds. On the service balcony, two off-duty workers played hockey with a wooden puck, briefly forgetting the endless repairs. The side towers' separate notes had begun to agree, but the new cargo drum kept interrupting them. He Yan closed his notebook and asked the director for one more day to calculate a replacement warning. Lu Que offered to watch the nests throughout the test. Neither man wanted victory if it came at the expense of people who could not choose the risk.
paragraphs.zh: 午夜前，他們追完第四聲道的路徑。它只在六年前增加，起因是外側雲航道發生貨船事故。主管當初想救人，工程師卻從未量測遷徙所受影響。何晏畫出利用既有緊急釋放拉桿、加設備用警報的新設計。陸雀標出停止信號跨越後能受到保護的休息懸崖。他們找到原因，卻還沒找到安全改法。 從鐘室窗外看，三座側塔在雲下微微發亮。勤務陽臺上，兩名下班工人用木製冰球玩曲棍球，短暫忘了無休止的維修。側塔各自的聲音已開始一致，新貨運鼓卻不斷打斷。何晏合上筆記，請主管再給一天計算替代警示。陸雀提出全程觀察巢區。若勝利的代價是讓無法選擇風險的人承受後果，兩人都不想要那種勝利。

questions.question: What is the purpose of the newer fourth sound channel?
options: To send stronger storm warnings to fast cargo ships.
To plant new trees on Orchard Island.
To let people read the thoughts of cranes.
questions.explanation: 第四聲道六年前為快速貨船加強風暴警報而新增。

questions.question: Why do He Yan and Lu Que object to simply lowering it for one night?
options: They want the bell company to lose all customers.
The unsafe setting could return once they leave.
The old manual forbids any maintenance work.
questions.explanation: 只降低一晚無法防止日後恢復有害設定，因此需可檢查的實體改造。

paragraphs.en: In the control room attic, with the custodian's permission, He Yan opened a locked box of letters written by the engineer who had built the extra channel. The engineer, Master Wen, was still alive but had retired to a nearby island. One letter described how the new drum prevented a deadly cargo collision. Another described the first season when cloud cranes stopped coming to the northern cliffs. The two events were separated by only weeks. He Yan asked permission to speak with Wen before changing his design. The accounting sheets were comparable across those years, but they could not describe the lives of the birds. Lu Que said he had come to adore the quiet moments when cranes cleaned their feathers. He Yan offered to conduct an independent test rather than demand a confession from anyone. The director sent a delegate to accompany them and promised not to interfere. They left the dusty attic through a narrow service stair.
paragraphs.zh: 控制室閣樓裡，何晏經保管人同意，打開一盒上鎖的信，信是當年設計額外聲道的文師傅所寫。文師傅還活著，卻已退休到鄰島。一封信描述新轉鼓如何避免致命貨船碰撞；另一封描述雲鶴第一次不再飛到北方懸崖的季節。兩件事只差幾週。何晏請求先與文師傅談話，再修改設計。 那些年的會計帳目可以相互比較，卻無法描述鳥群的生命。陸雀說，他已很喜愛看雲鶴安靜梳理羽毛的時刻。何晏提出獨立測試，而不是向任何人強求認罪。主管派一名代表陪同，承諾不會干涉。他們從布滿灰塵的閣樓走下一道狹窄勤務梯。

paragraphs.en: Master Wen lived in a cottage surrounded by reeds. He greeted the visitors without surprise, saying he had expected the bell to bring someone to his door eventually. He Yan showed the new measurements, and Wen recognized the dangerous pitch immediately. He admitted that the old test had used empty models, not living birds. He had urged the company to repeat the trials after the first migration failed, but his request had been delayed during a series of storms. Wen's devotion to saving travelers had produced an unexpectedly destructive result. He led them through a low doorway and showed a charcoal filter built for the drum. He had hoped to initiate a redesign, but the idea never reached the board. A legendary guild master had once predicted that strong bells would end all accidents. Wen now understood the likelihood of such certainty was very small, and his motive had not been enough to make the design safe.
paragraphs.zh: 文師傅住在蘆葦環繞的小屋。他不意外訪客到來，說自己早預料風鐘終究會把某人帶到門口。何晏展示新測量，文師傅立刻認出危險音高。他承認舊測試只用空模型，沒有活鳥。第一次遷徙失敗後，他曾要求公司重做試驗，但一連串風暴使要求被延誤。 文師傅致力拯救旅人的奉獻，卻造成意料外的破壞結果。他帶兩人穿過低矮門口，展示為轉鼓製作的木炭濾音器。他原想啟動重新設計，想法卻從未送到董事會。一位傳奇工會師父曾預言，強力風鐘能終結所有事故。文師傅如今理解這種確定性的可能性很低，善意動機也不足以使設計安全。

paragraphs.en: Lu Que asked Wen to describe the last day he saw a full flock above his cottage. The old engineer looked toward the reeds and spoke slowly. He remembered the sound of hundreds of wings and the sudden silence that followed when the new drum began to turn. He had chosen to believe the birds would return the next year. When they did not, he lacked the courage to go back to the company. Lu Que did not offer quick forgiveness; he asked Wen to help correct the harm now. A cold draft made Wen shiver, and a small crane outside began to sniff at the cottage doorway. The old man said no supreme authority could undo the lost nesting seasons. He passed He Yan a strip of rough metal, asking him to feel its texture. The drum's interior had the same pattern, a flaw that increased the harmful note. The knowledge had tormented Wen for years, but he had kept the sample rather than destroy it.
paragraphs.zh: 陸雀請文師傅描述最後一次看見完整鳥群掠過小屋的那一天。老工程師望著蘆葦，慢慢說起。他記得幾百雙翅膀的聲音，以及新轉鼓開始轉動後突然降臨的寂靜。他曾選擇相信鳥群隔年會回來。等牠們沒有回來時，他已沒有勇氣回公司。陸雀沒有立刻原諒，而是請文師傅現在一起改正傷害。 冷風使文師傅打寒顫，外面一隻小雲鶴在小屋門口嗅聞。老人說，沒有任何至高權威能撤銷失去的築巢季節。他把一片粗金屬交給何晏，請他觸摸質地。轉鼓內部有同樣紋理，那項缺陷會增強有害音高。這個認知折磨文師傅多年，他卻留下樣本，沒有銷毀。

paragraphs.en: He Yan studied the sample and proposed a narrow sleeve that could soften the drum without destroying its storm-warning function. Wen said the sleeve would have to be fitted during a still hour, when the drum moved most slowly. The next still hour was four mornings away. Lu Que asked what they could do before then. Wen suggested reducing cargo speed and using human signal boats along the most dangerous lanes. The company would not like it, but it could be done immediately. He Yan copied the sleeve design before leaving. Wen asked to come with them, even though his hands were no longer steady enough to fit it. Lu Que said the old engineer could teach the younger workers what he had learned and warn them against repeating the mistake. The journey back to the central island was quiet, but it no longer felt like two strangers carrying an impossible burden alone.
paragraphs.zh: 何晏研究樣本後，提出裝上狹窄套環，降低轉鼓噪音，卻不破壞暴風警報功能。文師傅說，套環必須在轉鼓最慢的止風刻安裝。下次止風刻還有四個早晨。陸雀問之前能做什麼。文師傅建議降低貨運速度，並在最危險的航道使用人工信號船。公司不會喜歡，但可以立刻執行。 離開前，何晏抄下套環設計。文師傅請求同行，雖然雙手已不夠穩，不能親自安裝。陸雀說，老工程師可以把學到的事教給年輕工人，也提醒他們別重蹈覆轍。回中央島的路很安靜，卻不再像兩個陌生人獨自背負不可能的重擔。

questions.question: What mistake does Master Wen admit?
options: He deliberately destroyed the first side tower.
He stole the silver wire at the auction.
He tested the new channel with models but not living birds.
questions.explanation: 文師傅承認早年的測試只用模型，未衡量對活鳥的影響。

questions.question: When can the proposed drum sleeve be fitted most safely?
options: During the next still hour when the drum moves slowly.
At the peak of a storm with the drum at full speed.
Only after every island has been abandoned.
questions.explanation: 套環須在每七日出現的止風刻、轉鼓較慢時安裝。

paragraphs.en: He Yan needed strong, flexible material for the new drum sleeve. A grove of copper-leaf trees on Orchard Island produced fibers that could withstand heat without losing their shape. The trees were protected, and taking too many branches would damage the next season's fruit. Lu Que suggested collecting only fallen leaves and old bark. He Yan calculated how many pieces were required for the sleeve and agreed that the repair could proceed slowly rather than strip the orchard bare. The island administration controlled the old grove under an antique land agreement. A bizarre sign warned visitors not to touch even fallen fabric-like leaves. He Yan wondered whether the rule had been written to conceal poor maintenance. Lu Que asked the keeper to explain the practical framework of conservation rather than argue about corruption. The first inspection found only gross neglect, not proof that anyone had stolen the trees.
paragraphs.zh: 何晏需要結實又有彈性的材料製作轉鼓套環。果園島的銅葉樹會產生能耐熱、不易變形的纖維。這些樹受到保護，砍太多枝會傷害下一季果實。陸雀建議只收集落葉與老樹皮。何晏算出套環需要的材料數量，同意讓工程慢慢進行，也不把果園剝光。 島上行政機構依一份古老土地協議管理樹林。一塊古怪告示禁止旅人連像布料般的落葉都碰。何晏懷疑規則是否為了掩蓋維護不善。陸雀請管理人解釋保育的實際架構，不急著爭論貪腐。第一次檢查只證明了嚴重疏忽，並沒有發現有人偷樹的證據。

paragraphs.en: They walked the grove with the orchard keeper, who showed them where older trees shed enough bark to make the sleeve. Young apprentices carried baskets and separated healthy material from spoiled pieces. He Yan tested each strip by bending it over a heated copper rod. The material did not snap. Lu Que examined the roots after the collection and found no fresh damage. The keeper agreed to lend the harvested fiber as long as the group replanted new copper-leaf seedlings. Some villagers greeted the travelers with hostility because they feared the forest would be taken away. An old icon of the copper tree stood at the entrance, and the keeper proposed that each household nominate a volunteer to watch the harvest. A small orchard rally formed beside the well. Rival farming groups argued, but the keeper persuaded them to measure how much material had fallen naturally. Their shared count helped practical evidence prevail over angry rumor, calming the dispute.
paragraphs.zh: 他們與果園管理人走遍樹林，管理人指出哪些老樹會自然脫落足夠的樹皮。年輕學徒帶籃子，把健康材料與腐壞部分分開。何晏把每段纖維放在熱銅桿上彎折，材料沒有斷。陸雀採集後檢查樹根，沒有新傷。管理人同意借出採得的纖維，條件是隊伍重新種下銅葉樹苗。 部分村民帶著敵意迎接旅人，因為害怕樹林被奪走。入口立著銅葉樹的古老圖像，管理人建議每戶提名一位志願者監督採集。井旁出現一場小型果園集會。互相競爭的農團發生爭論，管理人卻說服他們計算自然掉落的材料數量。共同計數讓實際證據勝過憤怒謠言，爭議逐漸平息。

paragraphs.en: That night He Yan worked beside the keeper's hearth, weaving the copper fibers into a narrow band. Lu Que sat opposite and treated a cut on his hand. He Yan admitted that he once measured a craft only by how quickly it could be completed. He now counted how many trees and hands had made it possible. Lu Que took the unfinished band and held it close to the fire so He Yan could test the color. Their hands touched briefly. Neither moved away. The village offered a small subsidy for replanting trees, and the apprentices felt a thrill when they found fresh shoots on seedlings in the nursery. A schoolteacher said the work could support tuition for future forestry students. The keeper cautioned that careless cutting would undermine the orchard more surely than any argument. He Yan described the repair as a shared venture, not a private contract. Lu Que agreed that its success would have to be measured in living roots as well as sound.
paragraphs.zh: 那晚何晏在管理人爐火旁，把銅纖維編成狹長帶子。陸雀坐在對面，替他手上的割傷上藥。何晏承認自己過去只用完成速度衡量手藝，現在則會計算有多少樹和多少雙手讓作品成為可能。陸雀拿起未完成的帶子，靠近火讓何晏測顏色。兩人的手短暫碰到，誰也沒有避開。 村子提供一筆小額補助重新栽樹，學徒在苗圃的樹苗上發現新芽時，十分興奮。一名教師說這項工作也能支持未來林業學生的學費。管理人警告，隨意砍伐比任何爭論都更確實會破壞果園。何晏形容修復是共同的冒險，而不是私人合約。陸雀同意，成功必須同時以活樹根與聲音衡量。

paragraphs.en: The finished band was light enough for one person to carry but strong enough to circle the drum. He Yan packed it with the silver wire and tested the new fastenings on a small wooden model. Lu Que placed fresh seedlings at the grove's edge before they departed. The keeper asked them to return after the storm and tell the villagers what happened. He Yan promised to report both failure and success, because the orchard deserved the truth either way. Across the valley, the spring wind sounded unusually low. He Yan checked the weather marks and noticed the storm front was moving faster than expected. The two men left before dawn, carrying the sleeve that might soften the bell and a responsibility to the trees that had given them its material. The road ahead now led straight toward the greatest danger of their journey.
paragraphs.zh: 完成的帶子輕到一個人就能搬運，卻夠結實，可以繞過轉鼓。何晏把它與銀線一起收好，在小木模型上測試新扣件。離開前，陸雀把新樹苗放到樹林邊。管理人請他們風暴後回來，告訴村民結果。何晏承諾不論成敗都會報告，因為果園無論如何都值得知道真相。 山谷對面，春風的聲音異常低沉。何晏查看天氣標記，發現風暴前鋒比預期快。兩人天未亮就出發，帶著可能使風鐘音調變柔的套環，也帶著對提供材料的樹木的責任。前面的路現在直通旅程中最大的危險。

questions.question: Why do they collect fallen copper leaves instead of cutting branches?
options: The fallen leaves are made of pure gold.
They want material without damaging the orchard's next season.
The orchard keeper forbids all repair work.
questions.explanation: 只收落葉與老樹皮可取得纖維而不傷害下季果實。

questions.question: What promise do the travelers make to the orchard keeper?
options: To keep the trees' location secret forever.
To sell every seedling to the capital.
To report the repair results whether it succeeds or fails.
questions.explanation: 何晏承諾不論成敗都會向提供材料的村民報告。

title: The Flock at the Western Gap

paragraphs.en: The spring front reached the western gap before the repair crew returned to the central bell. Dark clouds pressed against the islands, and the last large flock of cranes gathered on a narrow ledge. He Yan knew that the birds would try to cross once the first strong gust arrived. Lu Que counted the young birds and saw that several were too tired to follow. The two men called the side-tower volunteers and organized resting places along the repaired corridor. He Yan refused to attribute the flock's distress to any single person before checking the weather. On behalf of the village, Mei Sui offered a compact shelter near the gap. The volunteers showed great competence as they worked to coordinate supplies and signals. A young pilot was making his debut in a rescue crew, but the elder keeper reminded him that saving creatures was not a chance to prove personal destiny.
paragraphs.zh: 修復隊還沒回到中央風鐘，春季前鋒就抵達西方缺口。黑雲壓向群島，最後一大群雲鶴聚在狹窄平台上。何晏知道第一股強風吹來時，鳥群就會試圖渡越。陸雀數著幼鳥，發現幾隻太累，無法跟上。兩人召集側塔志願者，沿修好的風廊安排休息處。 何晏拒絕在查看天氣前，把鳥群的困境歸咎於任何單一個人。梅穗代表村子提供缺口附近的緊湊庇護處。志願者熟練地協調物資與信號。一位年輕飛行員首次加入救援隊，老守塔人卻提醒他，拯救生物不是證明個人命運的機會。

paragraphs.en: A cargo ship offered to carry the weakest birds across, but Lu Que refused to force them into its hold. Instead, he proposed moving food and water to two natural resting branches. He Yan calculated how long the branches would remain sheltered from the rising wind. He tied narrow strips of cloth above the safe ledges so that humans could see them without alarming the cranes. When the first young bird stepped toward a branch, he lowered his voice and waited. The sky above the gap lay outside the shipping guild's domain, so its captain agreed to carry donations instead of passengers. The crew had to execute a careful plan: protect animals that were not immune to exhaustion during migration. Their strongest worker, a muscular sailor, offered to climb the far tower. Lu Que reminded him that the birds were not opponents to be defeated; their needs set the rhythm of the work.
paragraphs.zh: 一艘貨船願意把最虛弱的鳥載過去，但陸雀拒絕把牠們強塞進船艙。他提議改把食物與水移到兩處天然休息枝上。何晏計算這些枝條在增強的風中還能遮蔽多久。他在安全平台上方綁上窄布條，使人類看得見，卻不驚擾鳥群。第一隻幼鳥走向枝條時，他放低聲音，耐心等待。 缺口上空不屬於航運工會的管轄區，因此船長同意載運捐贈物資，而不是旅客。船員必須執行細緻計畫：保護在遷徙中並非不會疲勞的動物。最強壯的水手主動提出爬上遠塔。陸雀提醒他，鳥群不是要擊敗的對手，牠們的需要才決定工作的節奏。

paragraphs.en: As the front approached, the red tower began to shake. He Yan climbed its lower steps and found a fastening loosened by repeated waves of wind. He could tighten it, but only if the next gust allowed a safe pause. Lu Que watched the flock from below and raised a blue flag when the birds moved back to the shelter. He Yan worked quickly, then came down without waiting for applause. The fastening held as the next heavy gust swept past. The side towers increased their output only when the weather required it. When a warning sounded, the volunteers had to scramble to lower the cloth markers. Beyond the gap, a spectacular pattern of sunlight crossed the cloud layers. A child held a sponge to keep rain from collecting in the tuning box, while a vendor brought spare roof tiles to strengthen the shelter. Every small act mattered more than a dramatic rescue pose.
paragraphs.zh: 前鋒接近時，紅塔開始搖動。何晏爬上低階，發現一處扣件被反覆風浪震鬆。只有下一波強風之間出現安全間隔，他才能鎖緊。陸雀在下方觀察鳥群，牠們退回庇護處時便舉起藍旗。何晏迅速工作，沒有等人鼓掌便下塔。下一股重風掃過時，扣件仍然穩住。 側塔只在天氣確實需要時提高輸出。警報一響，志願者就得急忙降下布標。缺口之外，陽光在雲層上形成壯觀的紋路。一名孩子用海綿避免雨水積在調音盒裡，小販帶來備用屋瓦，加固庇護處。每件小事都比戲劇化的救援姿勢重要。

paragraphs.en: By evening, most of the flock had crossed or chosen to rest. The youngest birds stayed on the near ledge under Lu Que's watch. He Yan sent a message to the central bell: the fourth cargo signal must remain low until the front passed. The director answered that the company could not hold the setting without risking cargo traffic. He Yan and Lu Que looked at the darkening sky and realized the temporary corridor would need a stronger protection before midnight. They drew one more map before night. It showed the places where people could travel without crossing the birds' resting ledges, and where human watch boats could replace the loudest bell signals. He Yan signed the plan; Lu Que added the positions of the nests. They sent copies to every island that could still be reached by messenger kite.
paragraphs.zh: 傍晚，大部分鳥群已渡過或選擇停下休息。最小的幼鳥留在近側平台，由陸雀看守。何晏向中央風鐘傳訊：第四貨運信號必須保持低檔，直到前鋒通過。主管回答，公司無法在不危及貨運交通的情況下維持這個設定。何晏與陸雀望向變暗的天空，明白午夜前臨時風廊需要更強的保護。 入夜前，他們又畫了一張地圖，標示人們可避開鳥群休息台地的路線，以及人工瞭望船能取代最刺耳鐘聲的位置。何晏簽下計畫，陸雀補上鳥巢座標。他們把副本交給仍能用信使風箏聯絡的每座島。

questions.question: Why does Lu Que refuse the cargo ship's plan for weak cranes?
options: He will not force wild birds into the ship's hold.
He believes all food has disappeared.
The cargo ship cannot carry a single basket.
questions.explanation: 陸雀不願強迫鳥入船艙，而改設自願休息的枝條。

questions.question: What causes He Yan to climb the red tower?
options: He wants to watch the sunset alone.
A fastening has loosened under repeated gusts.
A child has hidden the tuning fork there.
questions.explanation: 強風震鬆紅塔扣件，他在安全間隔中上塔修復。

paragraphs.en: Shortly after midnight, the great spring front struck the central island. The bell began ringing too fast, its fourth channel throwing a harsh note across the migration route. Cargo pilots signaled that they could not see through the clouds. He Yan reached the control room with the copper sleeve, but the drum was turning too quickly to approach. Lu Que ran to the lower observation deck and reported that the resting birds were lifting from their ledges in panic. Their first complication was a strict constraint: touching the drum at full speed could be deadly. The director presented an elaborate emergency chart, but sparks began to erupt from the control panel before he finished speaking. A metal fragment struck the floor. He Yan drew a graphic sketch of the failing mechanism and gave the crew a simple interpretation: the extra channel was feeding vibration back into the bell.
paragraphs.zh: 午夜過後不久，春季大風前鋒擊中中央島。風鐘開始敲得太快，第四聲道把刺耳的音調投向遷徙路線。貨運飛行員發信號說看不穿雲層。何晏帶著銅葉套環趕到控制室，轉鼓卻旋得太快，無法接近。陸雀跑到下方觀測台，報告休息中的鳥正驚慌地飛離平台。 第一個難題是嚴格限制：在全速轉動時碰觸轉鼓，可能致命。主管拿出複雜的緊急圖表，還沒說完，控制台就迸出火花。一塊金屬碎片打到地上。何晏迅速畫下故障機械的圖，向工人簡單解釋：多出的聲道正在把震動回送到風鐘裡。

paragraphs.en: The crew proposed cutting the fourth channel, but doing so would silence the storm warning for cargo pilots. He Yan said they needed to send one final warning first, then switch to the slower human watch boats already stationed along the route. The director hesitated because the company had never attempted that procedure. Lu Que pointed out that the old channels were still functioning. They could use them to carry one clear warning before separating the fourth line. The proposed intervention differed from mainstream practice, so the director asked who could qualify to authorize it. Lu Que explained the risk ratio between one controlled silence and hours of uncontrolled noise. A senator on the emergency call worried about lost shipping revenue. He Yan refused to tempt anyone with the promise of perfect safety. They could reduce one danger only by accepting a slower, carefully marked route for ships.
paragraphs.zh: 工人提議切斷第四聲道，卻會讓貨運飛行員失去風暴警報。何晏說必須先送出最後一次警示，再改用已經部署在路上的慢速人工瞭望船。主管猶豫，因為公司從未試過這個程序。陸雀指出舊聲道仍在運作，可以先用它們傳送一次清楚警報，再分開第四條線。 這項介入措施不同於主流做法，主管詢問誰有資格批准。陸雀解釋一次受控停聲與數小時無法控制噪音之間的風險比例。緊急通話中的參議員擔心航運收入損失。何晏拒絕用絕對安全的承諾誘惑任何人。他們只能透過接受較慢、標記清楚的航線，降低其中一種危險。

paragraphs.en: The signal went out. On the dark water below, human watch boats raised their lanterns one after another. The cargo pilots answered with blue flags and reduced speed. He Yan then pulled the release lever, opening the fourth channel's emergency gate. The drum slowed, but the damaged support began to bend. Instead of rushing forward with the sleeve, he told the crew to retreat and brace the frame from outside. Lu Que held the lower warning line until everyone had stepped clear. An unprecedented blast of wind passed through the chamber, creating a momentary vacuum behind the open gate. The central bell began to unfold its outer panels to release pressure. A seasoned warrior from the island guard helped carry the injured crew to shelter. He Yan checked for hidden heat radiation before allowing anyone near the drum again. The storm had not ended, but the harshest note had stopped crossing the nesting cliffs.
paragraphs.zh: 警報送出去了。下方黑暗的水面上，人工瞭望船一艘接一艘舉起燈。貨運飛行員以藍旗回應，並降低速度。何晏這才拉下釋放拉桿，打開第四聲道緊急閘門。轉鼓慢下來，損壞支撐卻開始彎曲。他沒有急著拿套環衝過去，而是叫工人撤退，從外側撐住骨架。陸雀一直守著下方警報線，直到所有人安全離開。 前所未有的強風穿過鐘室，在開啟的閘門後造成短暫真空。中央風鐘的外層板開始展開，釋放壓力。島衛一名有經驗的戰士協助搬運受傷工人到庇護處。何晏檢查是否有隱藏的熱輻射，才允許任何人再次靠近轉鼓。風暴尚未結束，但最刺耳的聲音已不再越過築巢懸崖。

paragraphs.en: At dawn the storm moved east, leaving the central bell silent for the first time in years. The cargo ships remained safe on the slow marked route, although their deliveries were delayed. Lu Que returned from the observation deck with news that the young cranes had settled again. He Yan sat on the floor beside the unused sleeve. They had not completed the repair. They had chosen a controlled stop over a dangerous victory, and that choice had kept both people and birds alive. Master Wen arrived with the morning inspection crew. He saw the open emergency gate and nodded without claiming that the old design had been right all along. He Yan handed him the broken fragment and asked him to help calculate a safer sequence for the next still hour. Lu Que walked beside them as the first pale light returned to the clouds.
paragraphs.zh: 黎明時風暴向東移動，中央風鐘多年來第一次安靜下來。貨船沿緩慢而有標記的航線保持安全，雖然交貨延後。陸雀從觀測台回來，帶來幼雲鶴已再度落下休息的消息。何晏坐在地上，身旁放著還沒用上的套環。他們沒有完成修復，而是選擇受控停止，不追求危險的勝利。這個選擇讓人與鳥都活了下來。 文師傅與早晨檢查隊一起到場。他看見開啟的緊急閘門，點頭，沒有宣稱舊設計從頭到尾都正確。何晏把斷裂碎片交給他，請他協助計算下個止風刻更安全的順序。第一道淡光回到雲層時，陸雀與他們並肩走著。

questions.question: Why is the fourth channel released during the storm?
options: The crew wants to cancel all spring travel.
The side towers have been completely destroyed.
It is feeding dangerous vibration back into the central bell.
questions.explanation: 第四聲道回送有害震動，必須在備用警示就位後安全釋放。

questions.question: What replaces its warning while cargo ships slow down?
options: Human watch boats and existing side-tower signals.
Untrained birds carrying written orders.
A promise that no more storms will occur.
questions.explanation: 人工瞭望船與舊側塔信號接替警示，貨船因此可以安全減速。

paragraphs.en: The islands woke to an unfamiliar quiet. Without the central bell's repeated warning, ship crews moved cautiously along the marked lanes, guided by watch boats and colored flags. The system was slower, but no vessel had been lost during the storm. In the nesting meadows, Lu Que counted the surviving cranes. Most had returned to shelter, though several were exhausted and one had died before reaching the western ledge. He Yan stood beside him, understanding that a safe ending for one night did not erase every loss. He Yan felt quiet affection for Lu Que, who kept caring for the birds when applause had ended. A temporary alliance of pilots, farmers, and healers agreed to authorize a slower shipping route. They carried water to a barren nesting patch and prepared a respectful burial for the dead crane. The town's planned carnival had been postponed, and its cooking tents were turned into relief kitchens instead.
paragraphs.zh: 群島在陌生的安靜中醒來。少了中央風鐘反覆警示，船員沿標記航道謹慎前進，由瞭望船和彩旗引導。系統變慢了，但風暴中沒有船失蹤。築巢草地裡，陸雀清點存活雲鶴。大多數已回庇護處，但有幾隻筋疲力竭，一隻在抵達西方平台前死去。何晏站在他身旁，明白某一夜的安全結局無法抹平每項損失。 何晏對陸雀生出安靜的深情；掌聲結束後，他仍在照顧鳥群。飛行員、農民與醫者成立臨時聯盟，同意授權較慢的航運路線。他們把水送到貧瘠的築巢區，為死去的雲鶴準備莊重的埋葬。鎮上原本要舉辦的嘉年華延後，料理帳篷則改成救助廚房。

paragraphs.en: The company director visited the meadow with Master Wen. He did not ask for forgiveness on behalf of the bell company. He brought a list of ships that had arrived late and the hospitals waiting for their supplies. Lu Que and He Yan studied it with the farmers. Some deliveries were urgent. Others could wait until the damaged drum was made safe. They agreed that every decision about transport needed to consider both those waiting at the docks and those living beneath the air lanes. The town monitored fuel consumption to keep the watch boats running. No one wanted to convict a mechanic simply for following an old order, but the director agreed to donate money for repair. Lu Que carried a jug of water past the stalled machinery. The new mechanism would need a public test before anyone called it an eternal solution. At the kitchen, volunteers served bread with mustard and warm soup to tired pilots.
paragraphs.zh: 公司主管和文師傅來到草地。他沒有代表風鐘公司要求原諒，而是帶來延誤船舶名單，以及等待物資的醫院資料。陸雀與何晏和農民一起研究。部分貨物十分緊急，其他的可以等轉鼓安全後再送。他們同意，任何運輸決定都必須同時顧及碼頭等待的人，以及住在航道下方的生命。 鎮上監測燃料消耗，確保瞭望船能繼續工作。沒有人想因機械師服從舊命令就定罪，但主管同意捐款修復。陸雀提著一壺水，走過停下的機器。新機構必須經過公開測試，才有資格被稱作長久解法。廚房裡，志願者把塗芥末的麵包與熱湯端給疲倦飛行員。

paragraphs.en: By afternoon, the red and blue towers were sending short, clear signals at agreed hours. The silver-wave tower waited until the reservoir crew confirmed stable water levels. He Yan wrote a schedule that named the person responsible at every station. He also marked a space for the person who might need to stop the next test. The director signed the plan, not because he had been forced, but because his workers had explained why the old arrangement could no longer continue. The director declared that the emergency route was operational and asked the crew to proclaim the change honestly. A few posters still carried propaganda promising instant speed without risk. Lu Que's rescue squad removed those posters and replaced them with current times and safety limits. Stability depended on accurate transmission of warnings, not vague claims that the sky would always obey human plans.
paragraphs.zh: 下午，紅塔與藍塔開始在約定時刻發出短而清楚的信號。銀浪塔等到水庫人員確認水位穩定才加入。何晏寫下時程表，列出每一站的負責人，也留下誰能停止下次測試的欄位。主管在計畫上簽名，不是因為被逼迫，而是工人已向他說明舊安排為何不能繼續。 主管宣布緊急路線已可運作，並要求人員誠實公告變更。少數海報仍有宣傳口號，承諾毫無風險的即時高速。陸雀的救援小隊把它們撤下，改貼目前時刻與安全限制。穩定取決於警告的準確傳送，而不是模糊宣稱天空永遠服從人類計畫。

paragraphs.en: At dusk, He Yan found Lu Que beside the youngest surviving crane. They sat for a long time without speaking. Finally He Yan said he had been afraid of disappointing him with another failed machine. Lu Que answered that the failure would have been pretending danger did not exist. He placed one hand over He Yan's, giving him time to move away. He Yan stayed. The next still hour was close; they would work again, but tonight they could rest. The meadow became quiet as the last relief boat returned to the dock. Lu Que covered the young crane with a light shade but left the path to open air unobstructed. He Yan put away the measuring cord and stayed beside him. Their work had brought them to an uncertain place, and neither needed to pretend the next morning would be easy.
paragraphs.zh: 黃昏時，何晏在最年幼的存活雲鶴旁找到陸雀。兩人並肩坐了很久，沒有說話。最後何晏坦承，他一直害怕另一臺失敗的機器會令陸雀失望。陸雀回答，真正的失敗是裝作危險不存在。他把一隻手覆在何晏手上，留時間讓對方退開。何晏沒有退。下個止風刻很快會來，他們還要再工作，但今晚可以休息。 最後一艘救助船回到碼頭，草地慢慢安靜。陸雀替幼雲鶴架起輕遮棚，仍讓通往戶外的路暢通。何晏收起測量繩，留在他身邊。他們的工作把彼此帶到充滿不確定性的地方，誰也不必假裝明天就會輕鬆。

questions.question: What does the rescue team do about the postponed carnival?
options: It forces all cranes to join the festival.
It turns cooking tents into relief kitchens.
It sells the damaged bell for decoration.
questions.explanation: 延期的嘉年華料理帳篷改作救助廚房，支援受影響者。

questions.question: What happens between He Yan and Lu Que at dusk?
options: They end their partnership without speaking.
They agree never to return to the islands.
They acknowledge fear and share a quiet affectionate moment.
questions.explanation: 兩人談及對失敗的恐懼，陸雀覆住何晏的手，何晏沒有退開。

title: The Repair That Had to Be Shared

paragraphs.en: The day before the still hour, the crew gathered beside the central bell to review every part of the new sleeve. Master Wen showed the young engineers which fastenings had failed in the storm. He Yan asked each station to name one reason it might need to stop. Lu Que reported the condition of the nearby nesting cliffs. They agreed that the repair could begin only if the watch boats remained in place and the side towers were ready to take over the warning. Their risk assessment was signed by a commission of workers from several islands. A carpenter brought a cedar coffin for the crane that had died, so the young helpers could take part in its burial later. He Yan struggled to conceive a schedule that left enough rest between jobs. The director accepted a temporary decline in cargo traffic and said he could envision a better system after the repairs, if everyone learned from the delays.
paragraphs.zh: 止風刻前一天，隊員在中央風鐘旁集合，逐一檢查新套環。文師傅向年輕工程師指出風暴中失效的扣件。何晏請每站說出一個可能必須停止的理由。陸雀報告附近築巢懸崖的狀況。大家同意只有瞭望船就位、側塔能接替警報時，修復才可以開始。 風險評估由來自多島工人的委員會簽署。一名木匠帶來雪松棺木，讓年輕幫手之後能參與死去雲鶴的安葬。何晏努力構想一份讓每項工作之間有足夠休息的時程。主管接受貨運量暫時下降，說只要大家從延誤中學習，他能想像修復後有更好的系統。

paragraphs.en: The following morning, the crews took their assigned places. The retired keeper listened at the blue tower, the mason waited beside the red sail, and the reservoir worker watched the silver-wave pool. At the central bell, He Yan checked the drum's speed with a handheld meter. Lu Que stood near the open gate, ready to signal if the cranes reacted badly. The sun rose, and for a brief moment the wind fell almost completely still. A judicial observer had been invited to make sure the repair rules were followed, not to direct the engineering. The day's milestone was the first safe fitting of the sleeve. A careless spectator tried to mock the cautious pace, but a nurse explained how much nutrient and rest the exhausted workers required. Tiny dust particles drifted through the still air. He Yan reminded everyone that the calm would end soon, and that the next command must be simple.
paragraphs.zh: 隔天早晨，各隊到指定位置。退休守塔人在藍塔聽音，石匠守在紅帆旁，水庫工人注視銀浪池。中央風鐘前，何晏用手持儀測量轉鼓速度。陸雀站在開放閘門附近，準備在鳥群反應不良時打信號。太陽升起，風在短短一瞬間幾乎完全平息。 一位司法觀察員受邀確認修復規則被遵守，不是來指揮工程。今天的里程碑是第一次安全安裝套環。一位粗心觀眾嘲笑謹慎速度，護理師卻解釋疲憊工人需要多少營養與休息。微小塵粒飄在靜止空氣裡。何晏提醒大家寧靜很快就會結束，下個命令必須簡短清楚。

paragraphs.en: He Yan and two workers guided the copper-leaf band around the drum. Wen read the fastening order aloud from the old manual. One bolt resisted, and the team stopped instead of forcing it. Lu Que noticed the air moving across the open gate and raised a yellow flag. He Yan changed the angle of the bolt, fitted it slowly, and then stepped back. When the drum turned again, the band held. The fourth channel remained quiet, while the older warning notes passed safely through the side towers. The retired keeper, who lived on a modest pension, thanked the younger workers for sharing the task. The repair had improved productivity only because it reduced harmful interruptions. For He Yan, the effect was more profound than any faster ship route. The mason's sibling, a young pilot, volunteered to make a solo flight outside the nesting corridor. He refused the stereotype that caution belonged only to people who were afraid.
paragraphs.zh: 何晏和兩名工人把銅葉帶套上轉鼓。文師傅照古手冊朗讀扣件次序。一顆螺栓卡住，隊伍停下，沒有硬扭。陸雀注意到空氣正流過開放閘門，舉起黃旗。何晏改變螺栓角度，慢慢裝妥後退開。轉鼓再度旋轉時，帶子牢牢固定。第四聲道保持安靜，舊警告音則安全地穿過側塔。 靠少量退休金過活的老守塔人感謝年輕工人共同完成任務。這次修復之所以提高生產效率，是因為減少有害中斷。對何晏而言，它的意義比任何更快的船線都深刻。石匠的手足是一位年輕飛行員，自願在築巢風廊之外單獨試飛。他拒絕「只有膽小的人才謹慎」的刻板印象。

paragraphs.en: One clear warning traveled from the central bell to each side tower. The blue note sounded first, then red, then silver. On the cliffs below, the cranes lifted their heads but stayed where they were. The human watch boats received the same warning through their lantern system, offering a second route if the bell failed again. The director declared the repair complete for the day. He Yan wrote down the remaining tests that would be needed before ordinary cargo speeds could return. No one thrust a victory banner into the air. The crews instead signed a treaty of maintenance duties between islands and listed subsequent inspections beside every tower. Lu Que watched a young crane stretch its wings in the clear afternoon light. He Yan met his eyes across the platform. Neither needed a grand speech to know the repair had changed what they could build together.
paragraphs.zh: 一聲清楚警報從中央風鐘傳到各側塔。藍音先響、接著紅音、最後銀音。下方懸崖上，雲鶴抬頭，卻留在原處。人工瞭望船也透過燈號收到同一警示，風鐘若再失效仍有第二條通路。主管宣布當日修復完成。何晏記下恢復一般貨運速度前仍必須做的測試。 沒有人猛然舉起勝利旗。隊員只是在群島之間簽下維護責任協議，列出每座塔後續的檢查。陸雀看著一隻幼雲鶴在清朗的午後伸展雙翅。何晏越過平台與他對望。兩人都不需要華麗演說，就明白這項修復改變了他們今後能共同建造的事物。

questions.question: What helps the crew safely fit the copper-leaf sleeve?
options: The drum's slow movement during still hour and clear stop signals.
Removing all support beams before starting.
Forcing a stuck bolt without checking it.
questions.explanation: 止風刻轉鼓放慢、停止信號明確，讓隊員得以安全安裝。

questions.question: What proves the warning route still works after repair?
options: Every cargo ship immediately doubles its speed.
The blue, red, and silver towers answer in order.
All the cranes are brought into the bell room.
questions.explanation: 修復後藍、紅、銀三塔依次回應，證明舊警示路線仍能運作。

paragraphs.en: When the bell became quiet enough for the cranes, people began preparing to use the skyways again. A school invited He Yan and Lu Que to explain the system to young apprentices before the spring market reopened. He Yan feared the lesson might sound like another proud guild lecture. Lu Que suggested beginning with an ordinary question: why had the birds refused the old route? They carried a wooden model and a basket of fresh leaves into the classroom. He Yan drew a carbon line across the model to show the old cargo channel. A chubby apprentice asked whether every island must conform to the same design. Lu Que welcomed the question and changed the discourse toward ecological differences among the islands. The class wrote a simple equation for weight and wind pressure, then made an explicit rule: no experiment could proceed unless the creatures had room to leave.
paragraphs.zh: 風鐘終於安靜到雲鶴能接受時，人們開始準備重新使用天空道路。春市重開前，一所學校邀何晏與陸雀向年輕學徒解釋系統。何晏怕課程又變成自大的工會演講。陸雀建議從普通問題開始：鳥為何拒絕舊路？兩人帶著木模型與一籃鮮葉進教室。 何晏用炭筆在模型上畫線，顯示舊貨運聲道。一位圓潤的學徒問，每座島是否都必須符合相同設計。陸雀欣然接受問題，把討論轉向群島間的生態差異。全班寫出重量與風壓的簡單方程式，接著訂下明確規則：任何實驗都必須讓生物保有離開的空間。

paragraphs.en: The apprentices tested the model with paper cranes. When the teacher tilted a fan toward the nesting side, the paper cranes blew against a wall. Lu Que did not call this a failure of the students. He asked what their materials had shown. A girl moved the fan to the far side, creating a clear corridor. He Yan measured the result, then let the class make the next change themselves. By noon, the students had drawn three workable routes for different winds. To make the change visible, He Yan offered to inject a little colored water into the glass wind model. The pupils then modified the opening and watched the color spread. A baker arrived with warm pastry for lunch, and the school's patron asked whether the lesson could become a yearly rehearsal. Lu Que agreed, provided the program included a scenario in which the safest decision was to cancel the flight.
paragraphs.zh: 學徒用紙鶴測試模型。教師把扇子朝築巢側傾斜時，紙鶴都吹向牆壁。陸雀沒有說學生失敗，而是問材料告訴了他們什麼。一名女孩把扇子移到遠側，形成清楚風廊。何晏測量結果，再讓全班自行作下一項修改。中午前，學生已畫出適合三種風向的路線。 為使變化更可見，何晏提議在玻璃風道模型裡注入少量有色水。學童接著修改開口，觀看顏色擴散。麵包師帶來熱糕點作午餐，學校的贊助人問課程能否成為每年排練。陸雀同意，條件是課程必須包含一個「取消飛行才最安全」的情境。

paragraphs.en: In the afternoon, the class visited the harbor to watch cargo pilots follow the repaired signals. The traffic moved slowly but steadily. Lu Que showed the students a tree whose roots held one end of the skyway, then asked them to measure its health rather than merely count the ships. One student discovered new leaves near a repaired anchor. He Yan wrote her name beside the observation and thanked her for noticing evidence he had missed. Beyond the harbor, engine smog still covered a narrow channel. He Yan said a sophisticated machine was useless if its waste harmed the nests below. The school garden grew squash for the relief kitchen, and pupils offered to submit a report about protecting the beds. When two ropes began to tangle on a practice frame, they stopped the test rather than pull harder. The youngest helper laughed at the old machine's stubborn whine.
paragraphs.zh: 下午，全班到港口看貨運飛行員依修好的信號通行。交通很慢，卻很穩定。陸雀帶學生看一株根系固定風道一端的樹，請他們測量樹的健康，而不只數船隻。一名學生在修好的錨點旁發現新葉。何晏把她的名字記在觀察旁，感謝她看見他漏掉的證據。 港口外，引擎煙霧仍籠罩狹窄通道。何晏說，再精密的機器若排出廢氣傷害下方鳥巢，也沒有用。學校菜園種了南瓜供救助廚房使用，學生提出要提交保護菜畦的報告。練習架上兩條繩開始纏住時，他們停止測試，沒有硬拉。最年輕的助手笑著聽舊機器固執的嗚鳴。

paragraphs.en: After the lesson, the school director thanked them for teaching both skill and restraint. He Yan remembered how he had once measured his worth by the number of repairs finished. Now he had helped students learn when not to repair something, or when to ask a question first. Lu Que asked whether he regretted leaving the old guild. He Yan said he regretted losing years to pride, but not the craft itself. The two men walked home through the quiet market street. A young graduate worried about unemployment after the old cargo system was replaced. He Yan invited him to join the island maintenance teams, where practical skill would remain necessary. Lu Que added that no new work should be invented merely to keep a machine running. They left the school a model anyone could take apart, study, and improve without seeking their approval.
paragraphs.zh: 課程結束後，校長感謝他們既教技能，也教克制。何晏想起自己從前只用完成的維修數量衡量價值。如今他教會學生何時不該動手，何時要先提問。陸雀問他是否後悔離開舊工會。何晏說，他後悔因自負失去的歲月，卻不後悔這門手藝。兩人沿安靜的市集街道走回家。 一位年輕畢業生擔心舊貨運系統更換後會失業。何晏邀他加入島嶼維護隊，因為實用技能仍會被需要。陸雀補充，不應只為讓機器繼續運轉而硬造工作。他們把可以拆解、研究、改良的模型留在學校，任何人都不必先得到兩人的批准。

questions.question: What principle do the teachers ask apprentices to follow?
options: Every repair must be finished before lunch.
A failed experiment must be kept secret.
Any animal must have room to leave a test.
questions.explanation: 課程明訂，參與測試的動物一定要有自由離開的空間。

questions.question: Why does He Yan value the apprentices' observations?
options: They notice evidence and changes he may have missed.
They can replace all tools with stories.
They are guaranteed never to make mistakes.
questions.explanation: 學生注意到新葉等細節，補足何晏自己可能漏掉的觀察。

title: The Road That Would Not Close

paragraphs.en: The great spring flock reached the central crossing seven days after the storm. At dawn, cold air began to descend through the western gap, and white wings filled the space between the islands. The repaired bell sounded three notes with clear pauses, and the birds answered by moving toward the quiet corridor. He Yan and Lu Que stood on separate sides of the nearest bridge, checking both its cables and the living roots. They had rehearsed the procedure, but a true migration carried uncertainties no model could contain. Under the maintenance accord, every island could stop its part of the route if danger appeared. The earlier storm had caused agony for families waiting at the docks, and the morning mist made distant shapes blur. He Yan asked the watch crew to browse their notes before the first cargo ship moved. A clean chord from the side towers confirmed that the sequence was coherent, and the pilots agreed to wait until the birds had chosen their path.
paragraphs.zh: 風暴過後七天，春季大鳥群抵達中央渡越。黎明，冷空氣開始沿西方缺口下降，白色翅膀填滿群島之間的空間。修好的風鐘以清楚間隔敲出三音，鳥群向安靜風廊移動作為回應。何晏與陸雀分站最近橋的兩側，既檢查纜線也檢查活根。他們已經排練過流程，真正遷徙卻仍有模型無法涵蓋的不確定性。 依維護協議，每座島遇到危險時都能停止自己負責的路段。先前風暴使碼頭等候的家庭深受痛苦，而晨霧讓遠物模糊。何晏請瞭望隊在第一艘貨船動之前先翻閱筆記。側塔傳來清楚和弦，確認順序連貫，飛行員同意等鳥群選好路線再通行。

paragraphs.en: Halfway through the crossing, a flock of smaller birds approached from below. The cloud cranes slowed and turned to avoid them. The two flocks began circling near the same narrow ledge, creating a risk of collision. Lu Que raised a yellow flag. He Yan lowered the nearby sail to widen the resting space, then asked the human watch boats to hold the cargo lane. No one tried to chase either flock in a chosen direction. A confrontation broke out between two impatient pilots, but the keeper reminded them that the old doctrine of speed had already caused harm. The execution of the safety plan required extensive coordination, not a shouting contest. Lu Que checked the index of nesting ledges and found another safe place lower down. A nasty gust struck the railings, yet no riot began. The crews followed the instructions they had practiced.
paragraphs.zh: 渡越到一半時，一群小鳥從下方接近。雲鶴放慢速度轉向避讓。兩群鳥開始在同一處狹窄平台附近盤旋，可能相撞。陸雀舉起黃旗。何晏降下附近風帆，擴大休息空間，再請人工瞭望船維持貨運航道暫停。沒有人試圖追趕任何一群鳥，逼牠們走指定方向。 兩名沒耐心的飛行員發生衝突，守塔人提醒他們，過去速度至上的信條已經造成傷害。安全計畫的執行需要廣泛協調，不是比誰吼得大。陸雀查看築巢平台索引，在下方找到另一處安全位置。一陣難纏的強風吹過欄杆，卻沒有引發暴動。隊員依照練習過的指示行動。

paragraphs.en: He Yan watched the birds settle on the lower ledge. The strongest gust passed, and a fresh opening formed above the western island. He signaled that the cargo ships could resume at reduced speed. Lu Que crossed the bridge to join him. The clouds parted just enough to show a long line of cranes moving in their own rhythm. He Yan smiled, not because the sky had finally obeyed him, but because the road had been made flexible enough to let it remain wild. One gust seemed to slap the edge of the sail, but the flexible fastening held. The crews did not soften the safety limits merely because the birds looked calm. Some spectators began to speculate about a secret scheme behind every old failure. Lu Que asked them to focus on what they could verify. A pilot's spouse offered warm drinks to the volunteers, calling their patient work worthy of the long morning.
paragraphs.zh: 何晏看見鳥群停在下方平台。最強的風過去，西方島嶼上方形成新的空隙。他打信號讓貨船以減速方式恢復通行。陸雀走過橋來找他。雲層剛好分開，露出雲鶴依自己節奏移動的長長隊列。何晏笑了，不是因為天空終於服從他，而是道路已夠有彈性，讓天空保留野性。 一股風像巴掌拍打風帆邊緣，但彈性扣件撐住了。隊員沒有因鳥群看起來平靜就放寬安全限制。有些旁觀者開始猜測，每個過去故障背後都有祕密陰謀。陸雀請他們關注能驗證的事。一名飛行員的配偶送來熱飲，說大家耐心工作，值得這漫長早晨的付出。

paragraphs.en: By noon, the last large crane had crossed, and the islands' markets reopened without a rush. The farmers measured fresh pollen on their flowers, while the shipping crews counted the safe arrivals. He Yan and Lu Que wrote down both results. They had not created a world free of storms or difficult decisions. They had built a route that could change when the wind changed, and a habit of listening before anyone pulled a rope. That evening the retired keeper invited everyone to the root-tower courtyard. There was no formal award, only soup, laughter, and a wall of notes naming the workers and children who had helped. He Yan returned the borrowed tuning fork to its keeper. Lu Que went to the nesting ledge one last time to make sure every young crane had a place to rest.
paragraphs.zh: 中午前，最後一隻大雲鶴已經渡越，群島市集不必匆忙便重新開放。農民量測花上新落的花粉，航運人員清點平安抵達的船隻。何晏與陸雀把兩項結果都記下。他們沒有創造一個沒有風暴或艱難選擇的世界，只修出一條隨風改變的路，也建立了每次拉繩前先聆聽的習慣。 當晚，退休守塔人邀大家到樹根塔庭院。沒有正式頒獎，只有湯、笑聲與一面寫滿幫忙工人與孩子名字的紙條牆。何晏把借來的音叉還給守護人。陸雀最後一次到築巢平台確認，每隻幼雲鶴都有地方休息。

questions.question: What do the crews do when a second flock enters the crossing?
options: They force both flocks to fly faster.
They stop cargo movement and widen the resting area.
They close every island for a year.
questions.explanation: 第二群鳥出現時，隊員暫停貨運並擴大可休息空間。

questions.question: What makes this final migration different from the first failed route?
options: Humans control each bird through a rope.
The islands no longer experience any wind.
Birds choose a flexible, quiet corridor with safe resting ledges.
questions.explanation: 新風廊安靜、可調整且有休息點，鳥群能自行選擇通行。

title: A Sky with Room for Two

paragraphs.en: Spring arrived across the nine floating islands without a single announcement from the central bell. The cranes brought pollen to the northern gardens, and new leaves appeared on trees that had stood empty for years. He Yan was offered a senior post in the restored wind guild, with a workshop near the capital and a steady income. Lu Que was asked to lead the seasonal habitat team on Bracken Island. For the first time, their plans for the future pointed toward different places. He Yan walked alongside Lu Que beside the canal that watered the new nursery. They discussed an alternate route for supply carts and why the city's old argument about communism and shared property had never settled who should maintain a public tree. What mattered was a crucial practical choice: the road would evolve only if the people living beside it could guide its use. He Yan loosened his grip on the capital's offer and asked what Lu Que wanted.
paragraphs.zh: 春天來到九座浮島，中央風鐘沒有為它發布任何公告。雲鶴把花粉帶回北方花園，多年光禿的樹開始長新葉。修復後的風工會邀何晏擔任高職，提供都城附近工坊與穩定收入。陸雀則被邀回蕨島領導季節性棲地隊伍。他們的未來計畫第一次指向不同地方。 何晏與陸雀並肩走在灌溉新苗圃的水渠旁。他們談運貨車的替代路線，也談城市過去關於共產主義與共有財產的爭論，從未真正解決誰該維護公共樹木。真正重要的是一個關鍵的實際選擇：只有住在路旁的人能參與引導使用，道路才會持續演變。何晏放鬆對都城職位的執著，問陸雀想要什麼。

paragraphs.en: Lu Que answered that he wanted to keep the nursery open to wild birds and young apprentices alike. He did not want He Yan to abandon his craft or accept a lesser future merely to stay near him. He Yan explained that he could build a small traveling workshop on Bracken Island and teach repairs across the other islands by season. He did not know whether such a life would be profitable. Lu Que said he could live with uncertainty, but not with a promise made without thought. He Yan presented a hypothesis: a traveling workshop could survive through shared repairs and seasonal teaching. Lu Que answered with cautious optimism and offered to help test the idea for one year. They wanted originality in the program, not a copy of the old guild's rigid orders. A poetic phrase from an ancient prophet was written above the nursery door: listen before the wind turns. Beneath it, a small pulse of sound came from the living root tower.
paragraphs.zh: 陸雀回答，他想讓苗圃同時向野鳥與年輕學徒開放，也不希望何晏為了待在自己身邊，便放棄手藝或接受較差的未來。何晏說，他能在蕨島建小型移動工坊，按季節到其他島教授維修。他不知道這樣的生活是否賺錢。陸雀說他可以接受不確定，卻不能接受未經思考便做出的承諾。 何晏提出一項假設：移動工坊可透過共同修繕與季節教學維持。陸雀帶著謹慎樂觀回答，願意一起試行一年。他們希望計畫有原創性，而不是照抄舊工會僵硬命令。苗圃門上寫著古老預言者留下的一句詩意話語：風轉前，先聆聽。門下活根塔傳來一點輕微的聲音脈動。

paragraphs.en: They opened the workshop together before the summer rains. Its rules were simple: every test had a clear stop signal, every student could ask questions, and no animal could be used to prove a machine's power. The first class included a former cargo pilot, two orchard apprentices, and the boy who had once guarded the road on Tin Island. He Yan taught them knots. Lu Que taught them to read feathers, leaves, and the movement of tiny insects before choosing where to build. There was no fixed quota of repairs to finish each month. A cooperative shareholder from the market offered tools rather than orders. When the first cranes began to soar above the roof, Lu Que asked the students to specify what they observed before celebrating. The sight was a stimulus to work carefully, not an excuse to hurry. He Yan saw a striking resemblance between the open sky above them and the first safe corridor they had built together.
paragraphs.zh: 夏雨前，他們一起開了工坊。規則很簡單：每次測試要有清楚停止信號、每位學生都能提問、任何動物都不能被用來證明機器力量。第一班學員有前貨運飛行員、兩名果園學徒，還有以前在錫島守路的少年。何晏教繩結，陸雀教他們在選擇建造地點前，先讀懂羽毛、樹葉與細小昆蟲的移動。 工坊沒有每月必須完成的固定維修配額。一位來自市集合作社的持股成員提供工具，而不是命令。第一批雲鶴在屋頂上方翱翔時，陸雀請學生先明確說出觀察所見，再來慶祝。這景象是謹慎工作的動力，不是催促的藉口。何晏看見頭頂開闊天空與兩人最初修出的安全風廊有驚人的相似。

paragraphs.en: One evening, after the students had gone home, He Yan asked Lu Que whether he would like to share the small house beside the nursery. He said he was asking because he wanted a life with him, not because the work required it. Lu Que took his hand and answered yes. They left the door open to the garden, where the last cloud cranes of the day were settling among the branches. The future remained changeable, but for the first time that uncertainty felt like a path they could walk together. At the next village gathering, the workshop gave every apprentice a repair voucher for one community task. He Yan returned the final borrowed measuring tool, and Lu Que placed a bowl of water beneath the cedar. Above the tree, the flock moved freely into a sky that belonged to no guild. The two men watched until the white wings became small points in the gold light, then went inside together.
paragraphs.zh: 有天傍晚，學生都回家後，何晏問陸雀，願不願意一起住在苗圃旁的小屋。他說自己這樣問，是因為想與陸雀共度生活，不是工作上必須如此。陸雀握住他的手，回答願意。他們讓通往花園的門敞開，當天最後的雲鶴正落在枝間。未來仍會變動，但這一次，不確定性像一條他們能一起走的路。 下一次村中集會，工坊給每位學徒一張社區維修工作的兌換券。何晏歸還最後一件借用的測量工具，陸雀在雪松下放一碗水。樹上方，鳥群自由飛向不屬於任何工會的天空。兩人看著白色翅膀在金光裡變成小點，然後一起走進屋內。

questions.question: What future do He Yan and Lu Que agree to test together?
options: A traveling workshop and shared life beside Bracken's nursery.
Permanent work in separate cities without contact.
A plan to capture every cloud crane for study.
questions.explanation: 兩人決定在蕨島經營移動工坊，並自願共同生活。

questions.question: What rule does the new workshop teach its students?
options: Only senior masters may notice dangers.
Every test has a clear stop signal and room for questions.
Machines must always be completed without delay.
questions.explanation: 新工坊要求每次測試有停止信號，學徒也有提問權。
